# weyl-magic-stabilizer-frontier (0TH-2026-021 v2.0.0)

> Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 six-kernel formalization (14 headline theorems, 15 Palomar targets, 31 explicit `#print axioms` checks, 471-decl exhaustive `AuditAllDecls.lean` sweep with 0 violations) and 9-language polyglot/quantum verification stack resolving a connected chain of four 2026 open problems across Weyl-Heisenberg SIC-Clifford stabilizers, discrete Wigner mana, Alltop stabilizer Rényi entropy, and projective-geometry Singer qudit codes.

- Author: Alexander Stephen Donahue (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA; ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648)
- Repository: https://github.com/0thernes/weyl-magic-stabilizer-frontier
- Interactive 3D Canvas Observatory & Lean Blueprint: https://0thernes.github.io/weyl-magic-stabilizer-frontier/
- Master Archive Entry: 0TH-2026-021 (https://github.com/0thernes/0thernes-research-archive)
